claimed_scope: Define and implement the smallest F2-native per-recipient delivery lifecycle/dedupe primitive for PENDING -> OFFERED -> ACKED, with immutable causal identity, replay-safe transitions, and no second state authority. Source/test work only; no provider/runtime/effect credit.
dependencies: F2-WP-100 UnifiedDB resolver/fingerprint (parallel, interface dependency only)
F2-WP-101 causal identity spine (parallel, interface dependency only)
non_overlap_note: F2-WP-100 and F2-WP-101 were already claimed by parallel workers at re-entry. This claim is confined to recipient-scoped delivery lifecycle semantics and deterministic transition/dedupe behavior; it does not alter their implementations.
acceptance_target: one explicit recipient-scoped delivery identity contract
mechanical PENDING -> OFFERED -> ACKED transition validation
duplicate/replay of an already accepted transition is idempotent rather than a second delivery
same causal payload for two recipients remains two recipient delivery records without becoming two world events
tests bind exact source identity and do not claim runtime or whole-system acceptance
hypothesis: A recipient-scoped monotonic lifecycle keyed by causal event plus recipient can prevent duplicate delivery while preserving one replay-stable causal event identity.
counterhypothesis: Recipient delivery state may need transport-attempt identity separate from causal-event identity; collapsing attempt and recipient lifecycle could hide retry/ack ambiguity.
discriminator: Implement the lifecycle so causal_event_id, recipient_id, delivery_id and transport_attempt_id are distinct; test duplicate replay, second recipient, retry attempt, illegal skip and stale-generation cases.
next_exact_action: Inspect current F2 package layout and donor delivery/reconcile semantics, then add the minimal typed lifecycle module plus deterministic unit tests without touching F2-WP-100/101 implementations.
